sar_narrative: The account of SYN_ff60eeb9 exhibited highly suspicious activity characterized by a high volume of inbound deposits across multiple counterparties and channels. Between 2026-04-25 and 2026-04-30, the entity received 25 transactions totaling $133,332.31, primarily via cash deposits. This activity is inconsistent with the declared purpose of a salaried wage earner with an expected monthly volume of $3,257. Specifically, the account displayed a smurfing fan-in deposit pattern, with multiple deposits from distinct senders such as AC800646, AC497399, and AC452737, often in similar amounts just below the $10,000 reporting threshold. The total inbound volume from distinct senders was $112,332.11, which is approximately 34.5x the declared monthly volume. This conduct appears consistent with structuring to evade reporting requirements under 31 U.S.C. § 5324. The matter is referred for further human investigation.
